candidates.source_name: European Commission — Enlargement and Eastern Neighbourhood: Ukraine country page
candidates.why_relevant: Master hub for Ukraine accession documents: annual Enlargement Report + country SWD, screening process news, cluster/chapter opening milestones. Chapter 9 (Financial services) sits in Cluster 2 'Internal Market'; screening was reported completed Sep 2025. This is the canonical entry point for EU-set, forward-dated obligations on Ukrainian banks/PSPs.
candidates.legal_status: public sector information, EU reuse policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of country page + /news filtered on Ukraine; capture linked PDFs (SWD country reports) for chapter-level text extraction
queries_used: EU Ukraine enlargement screening report chapter 9 financial services acquis

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex — Commission Staff Working Document, Ukraine Report (SWD(2025) 759 final)
candidates.why_relevant: The annual Ukraine country report is the single densest statement of what Ukraine must still align (CRR/CRD, BRRD, DGSD, capital markets acquis) and how prepared it is. EUR-Lex gives stable CELEX identifiers, making year-on-year diffing of the financial-services chapter mechanical.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: CELEX-based fetch + PDF text extraction; also EUR-Lex search/RSS on Ukraine-related SWDs each autumn
candidates.discovered_via_method: en web search, snowballed from enlargement portal
queries_used: EU Ukraine enlargement screening report chapter 9 financial services acquis

candidates.why_relevant: Task-level, dated tracker of Association Agreement implementation across ~24 areas, incl. financial services; reportedly >2,000 tasks and ~7,500 measures with named executors. Best structured Ukrainian-language view of which EU directive-transposition tasks are due, late, or done.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Inspect the site's XHR/JSON endpoints for a task API; else scheduled HTML scrape of the financial-services sector view plus the 'План заходів' document page
candidates.discovered_via_method: uk web search for monitoring system

candidates.source_name: National Bank of Ukraine — European Integration page
candidates.why_relevant: NBU coordinates negotiating Chapter 9 'Financial services'. This page and NBU news carry the internal EU-integration plan, EBA/EIOPA/ECB cooperation, CRD/CRR transposition regulations and equivalence work (e.g. professional-secrecy equivalence bill for EBA assessment). Mirrored in uk at bank.gov.ua/ua/.

candidates.source_name: European Payments Council — Criteria for the extension of the SEPA geographical scope
candidates.why_relevant: The formal, EPC-Board-approved criteria a non-EEA community (i.e. Ukraine) must satisfy to enter SEPA scheme geographic scope, plus the periodic continuous-compliance review. Defines the exact conditions driving Ukraine's AML/PSD-alignment legislative package.
candidates.access_status: open (document library; some items require free registration)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Document-library page watch + versioned PDF diffing
candidates.discovered_via_method: en web search on EPC participation criteria
queries_used: European Payments Council SEPA scheme participation criteria non-EEA country application register

candidates.source_name: EPC List of SEPA Scheme Countries (EPC409-09, versioned PDF)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative, version-numbered list of countries/territories inside SEPA scheme scope. The moment Ukraine appears (v8.0 dated 2025-12 observed as latest), that is the decisive, machine-detectable signal of SEPA admission — far more reliable than press reporting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll landing page for new version number; hash-diff the PDF and alert on any 'Ukraine' token
candidates.discovered_via_method: en web search, snowballed from EPC criteria
queries_used: European Payments Council SEPA scheme participation criteria non-EEA country application register

candidates.source_name: EPC Register of Participants (SCT/SCT Inst/SDD/VOP scheme adherence)
candidates.why_relevant: Once Ukraine is in scope, individual Ukrainian PSP adherence appears in the EPC Register of Participants — the granular indicator of which banks actually go live in SEPA schemes, and in which order. Commercially the highest-value single dataset in this cell.
candidates.access_status: open; register is a searchable/downloadable list
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic download of register export, filter by country code UA; confirm exact register URL at collection time
candidates.discovered_via_method: en web search, snowballed from EPC 'be involved' page
queries_used: European Payments Council SEPA scheme participation criteria non-EEA country application register

candidates.source_name: ECB — Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) pages / SEPA governance
candidates.why_relevant: ECB is the SEPA policy authority and (via the Euro Retail Payments Board and its oversight role) shapes conditions for third-country participation and euro-payments access. Also the venue for ECB Opinions on national legislation and for correspondent/TARGET access questions relevant to Ukraine.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS on ECB press/publications filtered for 'Ukraine' and 'SEPA'; watch ERPB meeting documents
queries_used: EBA European Banking Authority Ukraine NBU cooperation memorandum ECB opinion Ukraine

candidates.source_name: ECB Banking Supervision — Memoranda of Understanding with third-country supervisors
candidates.why_relevant: An NBU–SSM MoU (or its absence) is a hard indicator of supervisory-convergence progress and of whether EU parent banks' Ukrainian subsidiaries can be supervised on a consolidated basis. Page is an authoritative, low-noise list.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency page diff, alert on 'Ukraine'/'National Bank of Ukraine'
queries_used: EBA European Banking Authority Ukraine NBU cooperation memorandum ECB opinion Ukraine

candidates.source_name: European Banking Authority — publications, press releases and equivalence/confidentiality assessments
candidates.why_relevant: EBA assesses third-country professional-secrecy/confidentiality equivalence — a precondition NBU is explicitly legislating for. EBA guidelines also define the technical standards Ukraine transposes. Direct source for EU-side timing of an equivalence decision.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/press-release feed with keyword filter Ukraine / equivalence / confidentiality regime
queries_used: EBA European Banking Authority Ukraine NBU cooperation memorandum ECB opinion Ukraine

candidates.source_name: Ukraine Facility Plan portal (Ministry of Economy)
candidates.why_relevant: The Ukraine Plan 2024–2027 attaches money to dated, numbered reform indicators, several in the financial sector and EU-alignment space; quarterly disbursement conditionality makes these the most enforceable forward-dated deadlines in the country. Reporting indicates the indicator count rose from 146 to 173 and deadlines were shifted.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the Ukraine Plan PDF and any indicator-status pages quarterly; parse indicator tables into a deadline register
queries_used: Ukraine Facility Plan reform indicators financial sector EU acquis deadlines quarterly

negative_findings.description: No publicly published, chapter-by-chapter Ukraine screening report for Chapter 9 'Financial services' was located. Search returned news that screening completed in Sep 2025 and that bilateral Chapter 9 meetings occurred 13-14 February, but not a downloadable Commission screening report for that chapter.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the annual country report SWD and news items were found; screening reports for Ukraine appear not to be published per-chapter at accessible URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Screening reports are the densest source of directive-level, forward-dated transposition obligations; absent them, the annual SWD plus the Ukraine Facility indicator list are the fallbacks.

negative_findings.description: No EPC or EU decision admitting Ukraine to the SEPA geographical scope was found. Status as of the searches: Ukraine adopted preparatory draft laws (Dec 2025) and is not a SEPA member; the latest EPC List of SEPA Scheme Countries located is v8.0 (2025-12).
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukraine's SEPA accession is pending, with domestic AML/CFT alignment legislation as the observable precondition.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any claim that Ukraine has joined SEPA would be false today; the EPC country-list version diff is the correct trigger to watch.

negative_findings.description: No formal EBA–NBU memorandum of understanding, and no ECB Opinion specifically addressing Ukrainian legislation, was located in these searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Cooperation appears to be programme-level and informal so far; NBU describes strengthening interaction with EBA/EIOPA/ECB but no signed instrument surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Signing such an instrument would be a strong, datable convergence signal; its absence should be recorded as 'not found', not as 'does not exist'.

negative_findings.description: The EEAS-hosted EU-Ukraine Association Agenda PDF surfaced at a legacy path (eeas.europa.eu/ukraine/docs/st06978_15_en.pdf) which predates the EEAS site migration and may redirect or 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL recorded as a candidate example but unverified; a current copy likely exists on consilium.europa.eu or the Ukrainian government EU portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should resolve the Association Agenda from a stable host rather than a legacy path.

negative_findings.description: The EPC Register of Participants was referenced from the EPC 'Be Involved' page but its exact register/download URL was not pinned down in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register exists and is the granular adherence dataset; direct URL to be resolved at collection time.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is the highest-resolution indicator of Ukrainian PSP entry into SEPA schemes once scope is extended.

coverage_gaps.description: NSSMC (НКЦПФР, securities/capital markets regulator) was not directly scouted, although capital-markets acquis (MiFID II/MiFIR, CSDR, prospectus) is a large part of Chapter 9 and is named in Commission recommendations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add nssmc.gov.ua EU-integration and draft-regulation sections as a dedicated candidate; search 'НКЦПФР євроінтеграція MiFID імплементація'.

coverage_gaps.description: Consultation venues on the EU side (EBA/ESMA/EIOPA public consultations, Commission calls for evidence via 'Have your say') were not scouted for Ukraine-relevant items.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ec.europa.eu/info/law/better-regulation/have-your-say and the three ESAs' consultation pages with Ukraine/enlargement keyword filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Ukrainian-language coverage of EU-side bodies (EPC, EBA, ECB) is essentially nil — these publish only in en/EU official languages, so uk searching cannot reach them; conversely EU-side Ukrainian translations of screening material were not found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept an en-only collection path for EU bodies; use uk sources (NBU, CabMin, pulse.kmu.gov.ua) for the mirrored domestic obligation view and cross-link the two.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured, machine-readable register of 'EU directive -> Ukrainian transposition instrument -> deadline' was located; the information is dispersed across AA annexes, pulse.kmu.gov.ua, Ukraine Facility indicators and the annual SWD.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a derived deadline register by parsing AA Annex XVII, the Ukraine Plan indicator tables and pulse.kmu.gov.ua task exports; treat it as an internal join, not a source.

coverage_gaps.description: Council of the EU document register (register.consilium.europa.eu), where Association Council/Committee documents and negotiating frameworks are filed, was not queried.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the Council register with document-number search for Ukraine Association Council and enlargement cluster documents.

brief: Ukraine's forward-dated financial-services obligations are set in two EU-side stacks and mirrored in two Ukrainian ones: on the EU side, the Commission enlargement machinery (Ukraine country page, annual SWD country report, Ukraine Facility conditionality) and the payments/supervisory bodies (EPC geographic-scope criteria and versioned SEPA country list, EBA equivalence work, ECB/SSM cooperation pages); on the Ukrainian side, the Cabinet's 'Пульс Угоди' task-level monitor plus the annual AA implementation reports, and NBU as coordinator of negotiating Chapter 9 'Фінансові послуги'. The highest-value, lowest-noise triggers are version diffs of the EPC List of SEPA Scheme Countries and the Ukraine Plan indicator tables, because both convert political intent into datable, checkable events. Key negatives: no per-chapter Ukraine screening report was found in public form, Ukraine is not yet a SEPA member, and no EBA–NBU MoU or Ukraine-specific ECB Opinion surfaced. Main gaps to close next are NSSMC (capital-markets acquis), EU-side consultation feeds, and the Council document register.
